notes.subject: ir
notes.why_in_news: PM Modi assured Sri Lanka of continued support under 'Operation Sagar Bandhu' to provide humanitarian assistance and disaster relief (HADR) following Cyclone Ditwah.
notes.fact_box: India deployed INS Vikrant, INS Udaygiri, and MI-17 helicopters to assist Sri Lanka. Under Operation Sagar Bandhu, India has provided 53 tonnes of relief material and rescued nationals from 12 different countries.

prelims_pointers.text: Operation Sagar Bandhu: India's specific relief and rescue operation for Sri Lanka.
India has provided 53 tonnes of relief material to Sri Lanka as of December 1, 2025.
INS Vikrant and INS Udaygiri are Indian Navy vessels used for HADR operations.
Cyclone Ditwah: The specific cyclone causing devastation in Sri Lanka.
